title: Geghard Monastery, Kotayk
summary: Geghard Monastery in Armenia, built partly into the adjoining mountain, has a main church, Katoghike, finished around 1215 under the Zakarian brothers. A vestibule was added in 1215–1225, and further rock-cut churches and chambers date from the 13th century. The earliest foundation is credited to Gregory the Illuminator by tradition.

uncertainty.note: Both sources give 1215 for Katoghike (World History Encyclopedia says c. 1215). The monastery has older roots and later 13th-century additions. End is the present.

as_recorded.value: Katoghike (1215) was built during the reign of Ivane and Zakare Zakaryans
c. 1215 Construction of Katoghike, the main church of Geghard is finished
